title: Compliance Administrator
description:
Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.  

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock , TPG (The Rise Fund) , SoftBank, Glynn Capital , NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

As a member of the Customer Success Operations compliance team, you will support our clients’ 401(k) plans by completing compliance testing, preparing annual forms for filing with the IRS, and consulting on plan design. You’ll also be involved in the preparation of plan documents and amendments, and the creation of Form filings. In addition to the technical aspects of the role, you will also interact on a cross-functional basis with several teams, including onboarding, Customer Support, Relationship Managers, and internal operations, to ensure the best possible experience for the customers.

What you get to do every day

• Prepare and review compliance testing results (including ADP/ACP, Deductibility, Top Heavy, 401(a)(4), 402(g), 410(b), and 415) 

• Review and interpret plan documents to determine plan provisions, acting as a consultant to clients on recommended plan designs to meet their needs

• Prepare plan document amendments and notices

• Review QDROs

• Calculate annual contributions, including new comparability

• Review, prepare, and ensure timely filing of Forms 5500, 5330, and 8955-SSA

• Assist Relationship Managers with questions, problem-solving, and resolution regarding Compliance issues

• Assist auditors as needed

• Maintain up-to date knowledge of present legislation and proposed legislative changes with regard to ERISA law 

What you bring to the role

• 4+ years of progressive retirement plan experience, including at least 1 year of experience with compliance testing, annual IRS reporting requirements, and a comprehensive understanding of plan documents and Form 5500 Filings

• Knowledge of ERISA and IRS regulations

• Ability to research solutions and interpret technical literature

• Excellent spreadsheet knowledge, mathematical aptitude, and problem solving abilities

• Strong communication and partnership skills and the ability to explain complex issues to all levels within an organization

• Self-starter and passionate about suggesting and implementing process improvements

• Ability to work towards Industry designation within first 12 months (ASPPA, NIPA, etc.)

Why you will love working at Human Interest

Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges - closing the retirement gap. You'll be instrumental in architecting and scaling solutions that bring financial security to employees at small and medium-sized businesses nationwide. We’ve made significant progress, but there is still growth ahead, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and advance your career alongside a dedicated, mission-driven team. We value hard work and recognize that our team's contributions are key to our continued success.

Join Human Interest and make a lasting impact by shaping the future of retirement.

Our operating principles define how we work together as a team. They reflect Human Interest’s unique view on what’s important and what’s right. Documenting this core aspect of our culture helps employees make good decisions on their own. It also helps candidates considering career opportunities critically evaluate whether they will thrive at Human Interest.&n

description:
LLM Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: LLM Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $72,000-$100,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are looking for an LLM Engineer to design, execute, and operationalize fine-tuning workflows for large language models across supervised, preference-based, and reinforcement learning approaches. The role requires deep practical experience with modern training stacks, careful dataset construction, rigorous evaluation methodology, and the engineering discipline to operate complex training pipelines reliably. The ideal candidate combines strong ML intuition with production-grade engineering practices, and is comfortable navigating the trade-offs between data quality, compute budget, evaluation rigor, and shipping velocity. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners - product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders - to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Required Qualifications

• Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field; or equivalent experience.

• Six or more years of combined ML research and engineering experience, with significant LLM exposure.

• Strong proficiency in Python and modern deep learning frameworks, especially PyTorch.

• Hands-on experience fine-tuning transformer-based language models at non-trivial scale.

• Familiarity with distributed training strategies including FSDP, ZeRO, and pipeline parallelism.

• Experience with RLHF, DPO, or other preference optimization techniques.

• Strong understanding of evaluation methodology, benchmarks, and human evaluation design.

• Experience operating training jobs on GPU clusters and recovering from failures.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Track record of shipping or publishing impactful LLM work.

Preferred Qualifications

• Publications at top-tier ML venues.

• Experience with multimodal model fine-tuning.

• Familiarity with synthetic data generation and dataset distillation.

• Open-source contributions to LLM training libraries.

• Exposure to responsible AI evaluation and red-teaming practices.

description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Enterprise Marketing generates demand for Claude among businesses. Strategy & Operations is the operating system behind it: we run the cadence through which the org plans, decides, and holds itself accountable. This is a foundational role, and the systems you will own do not exist yet. You will not spend your first year arguing that the function deserves a seat. What you build becomes how Enterprise Marketing runs as it scales.

The operating rhythm is the center of the job. It is the weekly, monthly, and quarterly cadence through which leadership sees the right numbers and decides. It is how the org talks to itself: where information moves, where it gets lost, and whether the all-team meeting is worth the hour it costs. And it is the planning cycle. Twice a year, six functions, from product marketing to demand generation, have to agree on what Enterprise Marketing is doing and what it is not. You author the directional targets and define the framework everyone plans against, then aggregate what the functional leaders produce into one coherent story. They own their plans. You own the process, the math, and the coherence of the whole.

Underneath it sits an evidence problem. You will build a return on investment framework from scratch with our finance partners, connecting spend and headcount to output performance, then use it to set targets that hold up and tell leadership a story they can act on. You will also use Claude to make this team faster and more rigorous: what to automate, what to leave alone, and how to know the difference. What you learn becomes the proof Enterprise Marketing shows customers. 

Structure earns its place here by helping people decide faster. Process for its own sake does not. You write the memo, build the financial model, and run the meeting yourself.

Key responsibilities

•
Design and run the operating cadence: the weekly business review, the monthly all-team meeting, monthly finance and recruiting reviews, and quarterly business reviews. The weekly review is where decisions get made, not where status gets reported.

•
Improve how Enterprise Marketing communicates internally. Cut the noise in our written channels. Design all-team meetings and leadership offsites that produce decisions.

•
Run the annual and half-year planning cycle. Author the top-down directional targets, backsolved from the company's revenue goals, for leadership ratification. Pressure test those plans without holding authority over the teams that wrote them. Surface where a plan does not add up, and work with the owner to close the gap.

•
Aggregate the plans into Enterprise Marketing's input to marketing's annual priorities. When they exceed what the org can fund, bring leadership the evidence and the options.

•
Build the spend efficiency and return on investment framework from scratch, working with our finance partners.

•
Connect budget and headcount investment to output performance. Turn the analysis into recommendations executive audiences act on, and stand behind your numbers under scrutiny.

•
Baseline how Enterprise Marketing uses Claude tools and publish the first honest picture of where it is and is not doing the work.

•
Sequence what Claude should take on, set the success criteria before the work starts, and decide what should not be automated. Report what each change returned. That evidence is what Enterprise Marketing shows customers.

Minimum qualifications

•
Background in marketing operations, strategy and operations, or business operations, operating independently without program management or analyst support

•
Have built operating cadences, planning

title: Member of Technical Staff, Enterprise Evals Platform
description:
ABOUT MERCOR

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Enterprise agents are complex systems, and they only pay off when their work is reliable and economically viable. Evaluation is how you get both: checking correctness is the obvious case, and routing is the subtler one, since choosing a model against cost, latency, and quality requires quality to be measurable at all. Knowing where the bar sits is the hard part. You decompose real work, take the standard from the practitioners who hold it, and encode it so an agent cannot shortcut it.

You will apply what Mercor has learned building benchmarks with domain experts, and devise new methods, so that evals and rubrics keep improving and so do the agents measured against them.

That work only scales with a platform behind it. This is a platform engineering role with good depth of understanding in evals. You will build the verifiers, the environments agents are measured in, and the grading infrastructure that runs at scale, abstracted across customers, domains, and tasks so that every run becomes evidence the next agent inherits instead of starting over.

Read more about how we think about this: Agent Eval Systems https://www.mercor.com/blog/agent-eval-systems/

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Define golden sets: decompose real tasks and encode the expert quality bar.

- Build verifiers over agent trajectories and outputs, calibrated and hard to game.

- Build the eval platform that runs offline environments, task suites, and grading at scale.

- Run loss analysis over production trajectories and turn failure modes into regression tests.

- Run the optimization loop across models, prompts, skills, and harnesses.

- Own the rollout gates that decide whether an agent change ships.

- Partner with the Enterprise Platform team and the Applied AI engineers embedded with customers.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Professional, academic, or research experience in agent engineering and evaluation, including how agent runtimes and harnesses produce a trajectory and where it fails.

- Experience building evaluation suites for LLM or agent systems, and familiarity with how benchmarks such as terminal-bench, tau-bench, and APEX are constructed and where they get gamed.

- Judgment about task and rubric design: turning a fuzzy notion of quality into something measurable, with agent or model improvements to show for it.

- Strong software engineering fundamentals, and the ability to work independently on ambiguous, loosely specified problems.

- Bonus: experience with Harbor environments and RL environments.

WHY MERCOR

Lifecycle and Education team in general, and this role specifically, is highly collaborative and lies in the intersection of work across product, marketing, and GTM. 

Lifecycle Marketing is influential in defining and driving the user communication strategy, impacting the business by using a combination of analytical skills, creativity, and customer insight to craft and implement programs that result in measurable adoption, engagement, and revenue growth.

About the Role

As a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager, you'll own how Miro activates and retains new users, from the moment they sign up through the critical early days when they discover value and build lasting habits. This is the most pivotal stage of the user journey, and it's where you'll focus: designing and shipping onboarding and activation programs that get new users to value fast, keep them engaged, and turn first sessions into durable, collaborative use of Miro.

This is a builder role, hands-on, deeply embedded into product, AI-first, with the ambition to build intelligent personalization and tap into the new Lifecycle channels and surfaces. You'll join a fast-paced, growth-minded team, work cross-functionally, and own both strategy and execution end-to-end.

 

What you’ll do

• Design and build lifecycle campaigns focusing on onboarding and adoption, getting new customers to value quickly and keeping them engaged beyond their first session

• Partner with Product and Analytics to bring usage signals and turn them into dynamic, behaviour-based lifecycle programs spanning across email, in-app, and emerging CRM channels

• Operate with an AI-first approach across your whole workflow, using automation to accelerate content generation, personalization, segmentation, decisioning, and analysis

• Run experimentation and data-driven optimization as a default across every program, measuring true incremental impact and continuously sharing learnings and insights across the team. Own your metrics and reporting end-to-end

• Work closely with Product, Customer Education, PMM, and GTM so that lifecycle campaigns and content land as native, timely, and genuinely useful to users

• Get deep on our users' experience, lifecycle stages, and segmentation to uncover growth drivers and deliver tailored, personalized experiences to every customer

 

What you’ll need

• 7+ years in lifecycle/CRM marketing, growth, or a related discipline, including hands-on experience in B2B SaaS building email campaigns, automation flows, and multi-channel lifecycle programs

• Experience building dynamic, highly personalized, evolving lifecycle systems, not just static journeys and blasts. Proven examples of nurture and re-engagement programs that converted and drove measurable impact on activation, adoption, and retention

• Deeply fluent in Braze or a similar marketing automation platform. You build your own workflows, segmentation logic, and triggers hands-on. Experience working with CDPs and event pipelines to power behaviour-based, real-time lifecycle programs

• Strong analytical instincts, ability to see and diagnose the full journey, and zoom in to very specific details. Comfort using data to drive prioritization and decision-making

• Hands-on experience applying AI and automation to segmentation, personalization and smart decisioning, content creation, and insights and reporting

• Obsession with craft and a high-quality bar for content. Able to create copy and visual storytelling across lifecycle channels that resonates and drives action

• Growth mindset with a drive to launch fast and iterate, building systems that evolve over time. Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment and ambiguity

Temporal is growing and we are looking for those who share our values, challenge 'standard' thinking, and want to influence our future. If you have a passion for improving the developer experience, building world-class open-source software and communities, and want to be a part of our amazing team, we'd love to hear from you!

Summary

We are a high-growth, private, consumption-based software company seeking a Vice President, Global Controller to build and lead our accounting, tax, treasury, and procurement functions. This is a rare opportunity for a hands-on financial leader to own the full accounting and operating infrastructure of a scaling business, partner closely with the CFO and executive team, and help architect the systems, controls, and international footprint needed to support the company's next phase of growth.

What You'll Do

• Own all aspects of global accounting operations, including the monthly and quarterly close, consolidations, technical accounting (including usage-based/consumption revenue recognition under ASC 606), and financial reporting.

• Lead corporate tax strategy and compliance, including domestic and international tax planning, transfer pricing, and indirect tax (sales/use, VAT/GST) as the company expands globally.

• Guide international expansion from a finance and accounting perspective: entity structuring, local statutory and tax compliance, and building out finance operations in new markets.

• Partner with the CFO and cross-functional leaders (Legal, Sales, Revenue Operations) on deal structuring, contract review, and revenue recognition for new consumption-based pricing models.

• Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing global accounting and tax team as the organization grows.

• Deliver accurate, timely financial reporting to executive leadership, the board of directors, and investors.

What You'll Bring

• 12+ years of progressive accounting/finance experience, including significant leadership experience in a high-growth SaaS or consumption/usage-based software company for both private and public companies.

• CPA required; Big 4 public accounting background strongly preferred.

• Deep expertise in US GAAP, including ASC 606 revenue recognition for consumption/usage-based models.

• Proven experience building or scaling tax and treasury functions, including international tax and multi-entity/multi-currency operations.

• Track record of scaling accounting infrastructure and teams through periods of rapid growth, ideally including international expansion.

• Experience preparing an organization for an IPO is strongly preferred.

• Experience owning or partnering closely

title: Senior Director, Finance Business Partner – Optical Circuit Switch (OCS)
description:
PsiQuantum’s mission is to build the first useful quantum computers-machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.  

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.  

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry-including partners like GlobalFoundries-we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don’t feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.  

In 2024, PsiQuantum announced government-funded projects to support the build-out of our first utility-scale quantum computers in Brisbane, Australia, and Chicago, Illinois. These initiatives reflect a growing recognition that quantum computing will be strategically and economically defining-and that now is the time to scale.  

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies-including Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical-to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact.  

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift-and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we have a clear path to make it real.  

Come join us.

title: Driver / Data Collector in Alençon, France
description:
Company description
 
Terry Soot Management Group (TSMG) is a field data collection company founded in 2017 in Europe. 
We collect data where automation is not possible. We count features, take pictures, make videos, record speech, and scan areas for every detail you need to make more informed decisions. Our field data collection teams are spread across Europe and North America, ready to accept new challenges.
 
Project objective
 
The goal of the project is to help collect images of streets, main points of interest and public areas in the EU countries. The project is performed on cars with 360 cameras mounted on top that image the area around the vehicle and store those images on computers inside the vehicle. Later, this data will be used to enhance one the most popular online maps in the world.
 
The data collectors will be given specific routes around public streets and areas, specifically targeting commercial districts and historical sites. Due to poor weather conditions some areas will be visited multiple times in order to collect the best quality of imaging. The project is expected to last from 3 to 6 months and will cover different data collection areas. 
 
The ideal candidate enjoys driving, knows well the area, traffic trends, is highly responsible and reliable.
 
The schedule expected on the project is Monday-Friday, 8 hours/day 40 hours per week. Due to weather downtime, work on weekends is possible.

title: Fleet Software Engineer (Multiple Levels)
description:
About Pyka
Pyka’s goal is to provide society with a new form of safe, clean, and cost-effective transportation enabled by autonomous electric aviation.
To get there, we’re taking a different approach than most. We're applying our technologies to every industry where autonomous electric aircraft can be useful, starting with the highest value and most dangerous jobs. In doing so, we're building game-changing products manufactured at scale, while perfecting the safety, reliability, and capabilities of our autonomy engine and electric propulsion systems. 
We design, develop and manufacture an ecosystem of technologies including proprietary flight control software, avionics, high power density motors, motor controllers, batteries, and custom carbon-fiber composite airframes.
Today, we supply autonomous electric aircraft for cargo transport and crop protection to real-world customers across four separate continents and have secured industry-first regulatory approvals from the FAA. Our cargo aircraft enables remote connectivity, enhances express delivery networks, and ensures fast and reliable shipping of critical supplies to areas in need. Our crop protection aircraft offers agricultural services providers and farmers an autonomous tool to make aerial application safer, more precise, and less harmful to surrounding environments. Both vehicles are highly economical to operate, easy to deploy, and significantly reduce CO2 emissions in their respective industries. 
What you work on at Pyka makes people’s lives better now and brings the future of electric aviation one step closer each day. 

Role Overview
Pyka is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to be the software owner of our Dropship and Cargo programs. The software problems in these programs span the stack: path planning over long ranges, controls for a new airframe, integration of new sensors, engine control and state-of-charge management on a hybrid powertrain, and incorporating weather into how a mission is planned and flown. You will be responsible for the software behavior of these aircraft as a whole - what it needs to do, how the pieces fit together, and whether it is ready to fly - and you will be the engineer the Dropship team comes to when software is the open question on their side.
 
Some of the current and future projects you will likely contribute to include:
Path planning for long-range cargo missions that accounts for energy state, winds aloft, and weather along the route
Energy management on a hybrid powertrain: engine control, state-of-charge policy, and how the aircraft trades power against range, payload, and reserve
Flight controls and handling for a new airframe, from simulation through flight test
Integrating new sensors and payload systems, and defining the software needs before the hardware is fixed
Turning operational feedback from cargo flights into requirements for the next iteration of the aircraft
Defining what mission planning and ground tools need to expose to operators flying these aircraft

Export Control Requirements
This position requires access to technology, software and other information that is subject to governmental access control restrictions, due to export controls.  Employment in this position is conditioned on the continued availability of government authorization to authorize release of such items, to the extent required, including without limitation an export license, or other documentation required to establish authorization to receive access to such items. 
Company may delay commencement of employment, rescind an offer of employment, terminate employment, and/or may modify job responsibilities, compensation, benefits, and/or access to Company facilities and information systems, as Company deems appropriate, in order to ensure compliance with applicable government access control restrictions.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Platform
description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Harvey is generating far more data than we currently know how to use well. Product telemetry, agent execution traces, model usage, customer engagement, financial and operational systems - the volume and the number of teams who need to work with it are both growing faster than any single team can serve by hand.

As one of the first hires on our central data platform team, you'll build the systems that let every team at Harvey work with data confidently and independently. This is a platform charter, not a pipeline queue: you're building the frameworks, tooling, and paved paths that product engineers, data engineers, and analysts all build on, and you're measured by their leverage and general trust in our data systems.

The near-term foundation is ingestion and the warehouse - reliable streaming and batch paths into Snowflake, CDC off production systems, orchestration, and schema evolution that absorbs upstream change instead of breaking under it, and factors in the hard data sensitivity requirements our domain requires.

From there the charter expands to the rest of what a modern data platform owes its users: transformation and compute frameworks, self-serve tooling so teams can stand up their own pipelines against well-tested primitives, real-time and stream processing for products and internal systems that can't wait for a nightly batch, and the quality, lineage, and governance layers that make the whole thing trustworthy. Handling PII correctly and honoring multi-region data residency aren't nice to have features here - they're constraints the platform has to satisfy by construction, for customers who are among the most security-conscious institutions in the world.

You'll sit between Analytics, Data Engineering, product teams, and Infrastructure. Today this work is distributed and improvised. You'll make it a system, set the technical direction, and help build the team around you.

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As Engineering Manager in Vinted's Platform organisation, you will be responsible for leading a team that shapes how engineers - and increasingly AI agents - build, test, and ship software at Vinted. We are hiring 2 Engineering Managers: one to lead the Developer Portal team, and one to lead the Developer Environments team. Both roles share the same mission: making the use of Vinted's Platform feel like using a product for humans and agents alike.

The Developer Portal team owns the entry point to Vinted's Platform - the place engineers go to discover capabilities, understand ownership and requirements, start and track workflows, and inspect the state of their services across Web UI, CLI, and MCP/agent integrations. It works through federation: capability owners publish through a shared contribution framework, while the team owns the product experience that ties it all together. The Developer Environments team owns the environments where code gets built and verified: on-demand development environments with realistic seed data, isolated sandboxes where multiple autonomous coding agents can work the same repository concurrently, and the paths that let changes move from plan to production with minimal human toil.

Both teams sit at the core of Vinted's AI adoption strategy, which shifts engineers toward architecture and planning while AI agents autonomously implement, test, deploy, and monitor. You will report to Artūras Vedrickas, and work closely with Platform capability owners, the Agentic Platform team, Product Engineers across all domains, and Security.

In this position, you’ll 

• Lead a team of engineers building internal products that hundreds of colleagues and a fast-growing population of AI agents rely on every single day

• Shape your team's vision, scope, and quarterly objectives with your stakeholders, and be accountable for turning initiatives into shipped, adopted outcomes - not just merged code

• Create golden paths so that the common journeys - spin up a service, provision a resource, get a test environment, understand what broke - take minutes of focused effort

• Drive outcomes you can actually measure: journey completion time, self-service rate, how ready our repositories and workflows are for agents to work in them

• Own delivery for your team: spotting dependencies early, clearing obstacles, tracking milestones, and stepping in when the plan meets reality

• Ensure the quality of engineering - sound principles, meaningful SLOs, incidents met with fas

title: Territory Partner (Field Sales)
description:
THE ROLE

Omada AI is the AI marketing platform built for small businesses - and we grow the old-fashioned way: in person, face to face, business by business. Territory Partners are the front line of that motion.

This is a true field sales role. You'll walk into local businesses, pitch owners directly, and get them live on Omada the same day. You find your own prospects, build your own pipeline, and close your own deals. There's no cold-call center behind you and no calendar of pre-booked meetings waiting when you log in - the TPs who win here are the ones who don't need one.

If you've done outside sales before and you know the feeling of turning an empty morning into three signed customers by dinner, keep reading.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Prospect your territory relentlessly. Identify, approach, and pitch local SMBs - walk-ins, door pulls, referrals, local networking, whatever works. You own your pipeline end to end.

- Sell in person. Pitch business owners face to face and get them started in a live free trial on the spot - we don't do demos or demo accounts. You build their system on their real business, with their real content, in front of them.

- Run the full sales cycle. From first conversation through trial activation to paid conversion, the deal is yours.

- Master the product fast. Omada is straightforward to learn and pitch - most reps are confidently selling within their first day or two. The hard part isn't the product; it's the hustle. That's why we hire for the hustle.

- Report and improve daily. Track your activity, present your accounts in team reviews, and sharpen your close rate week over week.

HOW WE SET YOU UP TO WIN

- Two-week apprenticeship. You start paired with a veteran Territory Partner: shadow their pitches, then prospect together, then close your own deals with their help (with commission split during the ramp). No classroom fluff - you learn this job by doing this job next to someone who's great at it.

- Proving Ground. Our performance-gated ramp structure rewards producers quickly. Hit your numbers and your earnings and territory opportunities grow with you.

- A real career ladder. TP → Vanguard → City Captain → State Director → Regional Director → Country Manager. We promote from the field, full stop.

- A product that sells. SMB owners need marketing help, most can't afford an agency, and Omada does the work of one for a fraction of the price. When you get in front of the right owner, this sells.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required:

- Proven field / outside sales experience - you've sold face to face before (D2D, B2B field, territory sales, retail energy/telecom/payments, or similar) and you have the numbers to show for it

- Demonstrated self-prospecting ability - you've built your own pipeline from zero and you're comfortable walking into a business cold

- Closer's mentality - you ask for the business, handle objections in the moment, and don't leave without a next step

- Self-managed and disciplined - you run your day like a business owner, because as a 1099 contractor, you are one

- Reliable transportation and the ability to work your territory in person daily

You'll thrive here if:

- You'd rather be paid for what you produce than for showing up

- You like small business owners and can talk to a plumber, a salon owner, and a realtor in the same afternoon

- You're energized (not intimidated) by rejection volume

- You want a shot at building and leading a market, not just working one

This is not for you if:

- You're looking for a role where meetings are booked for you

- You need warm leads handed over to get going

- You've only sold over the phone or by email and aren't sure about face-to-face

COMPENSATION

Commission-based with performance-gated ramp compensation through our Proving Ground structure. Top producers earn well above typical field sales roles - your income is a direct function of your production. Full details shared during the interview process.

ABOUT OMADA AI

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. We are responsible for enabling a stellar developer experience for frontend engineers at Stripe . We're hiring a deeply technical product manager to own the platform strategy, drive cross-company modernization initiatives, and set the standard for frontend excellence at Stripe .
What you'll do
How should a platform team decide what to build when 50 teams depend on you and each one thinks their request is the most urgent? When do you invest in long-term architectural health versus shipping the migration that unblocks next quarter's goal? How do you make 9,000 files at initialization become a fast, traceable, joyful developer experience-without breaking production for millions of merchants along the way?

• Own the product strategy and roadmap for Stripe 's frontend platform

• Drive the largest frontend modernization initiative at Stripe while holding the line on architectural quality

• Redefine frontend development with agentic tooling

• Define and track key metrics such as latency, build times, and reliability SLOs to make difficult trade-off decisions

• Be the product voice in deeply technical decisions such as API surface design, framework deprecation sequencing, extraction boundaries, and migration tooling

You think in systems, not features. You go deep on architecture, you don't delegate to engineering. You're the person who reads the RFC before the meeting, asks why the error response looks like that, and frames migrations in terms of user outcomes, not just engineering milestones. • 7+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years on platform, infrastructure, or developer tools teams

• Experience driving large-scale migrations or platform transitions across multiple teams, including the sequencing, dependency management, and stakeholder alignment that make them succeed

• Demonstrated use of quantitative metrics to drive platform investment decisions-you've defined the metrics, not just tracked them

• Track record of partnering with engineering to make architectural trade-offs grounded in user impact

• Led or significantly contributed to a legacy extraction or monolith decomposition effort and understand viscerally why they're hard and where they get stuck

title: Senior Embedded Linux / Android Camera Engineer
description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe. Join a long-term international engineering project delivered by Jabil and work on advanced embedded camera and video technologies for a global leader in smart automation and control systems.
This is an opportunity for an experienced Camera / Embedded Linux Engineer who enjoys working close to the hardware and deep inside the Linux and Android camera stack-solving the complex problems that happen where image sensors, drivers, kernel, ISP, multimedia frameworks, and Android come together.
You’ll contribute to a unified camera technology platform powering multiple product families used in conference rooms, classrooms, auditoriums, home offices, and enterprise environments worldwide. Your work will have a direct impact on camera performance, video quality, system stability, and the overall user experience of commercially deployed products.
Deep Camera & Embedded Linux Engineering
Rather than working only at the application layer, you’ll have the opportunity to investigate and solve problems across the complete camera pipeline, from hardware interfaces and Linux kernel drivers through Android and multimedia frameworks.
Solve Problems That Require Real Engineering
You may find yourself analyzing kernel logs and driver behavior, tracing frames through V4L2 and the ISP, debugging MIPI CSI-2 communication, investigating Android Camera HAL behavior, tuning GStreamer pipelines, or determining whether a difficult problem originates in the sensor, hardware interface, kernel, driver, multimedia stack, or higher software layers.
Technical Ownership & Global Product Impact
We value senior engineers who want more than a predefined list of implementation tasks. You’ll have the opportunity to own complex technical topics from investigation through solution, contribute to architecture and engineering decisions, and work directly with globally distributed technical stakeholders.
Required Expertise

Must have

• 8+ years of embedded/low-level development experience, with 4-5+ years focused on Linux / Android BSP and camera or multimedia subsystem integration

• Strong C/C++ programming skills

• Strong experience with Linux kernel camera drivers and V4L2 (including sub-device drivers )

• Proven experience integrating and maintaining Android Camera HAL

• Hands-on experience with camera sensor bring-up and board-level integration

• Experience working with Device Tree / DTBO overlays , including power sequencing , reset , and clock (MCLK) configuration

• Experience with ISP and image quality (IQ) pipelines , including:

•
3A algorithms (AE, AWB, AF) ,

•
Lens Shading Correction (LSC) ,

• Temporal Noise Reduction (TNR)

• Ability to debug complex camera pipelines across kernel and user space

• Experience with Git/Gerrit and build systems ( Yocto or AOSP )

• Strong understanding of embedded Linux and Android system architecture

• Experience with camera validation and debugging frameworks .

• Strong verbal and written communication skills , with the manner to effectively collaborate for the successful project delivery and to take ownership of complex technical challenges .

Nice to have

• Experience with Qualcomm’s CHI pipeline

• Experience with ISP pipelines and proprietary HAL implementations

• Knowledge of multimedia frameworks such as GStreamer or OpenCV

• Experience working with high-resolution or multi-camera systems

• Familiarity with automated validation frameworks for camera subsystems

title: Technical Product Manager, Experimentation Platform
description:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

KAYAK is seeking a Technical Product Manager to lead the development and evolution of its experimentation platform. This is a role with global scope and clear accountability for the roadmap, prioritization, adoption, and success of a strategic platform that supports A/B testing today and will expand over time to broader testing use cases across the company! You will work closely with Engineering, Data, and Product partners and help a small cross-functional team deliver a platform that enables faster, more trusted decision-making across KAYAK.

Note, this position is required to work from our Concord, MA office 3 days per week.

In this role you will:

- Own the roadmap for KAYAK's experimentation platform, aligning priorities with business goals and platform needs.

- Define and communicate a clear product direction, from current A/B testing capabilities to broader testing use cases over time.

- Partner closely with Engineering, Data, and Product teams to shape features, requirements, and implementation plans.

- Translate user needs and ambiguous asks into clear product requirements and well-scoped initiatives.

- Define success metrics, drive adoption, and continuously improve the platform through data and partner feedback.

- Improve experiment setup, execution, monitoring, analysis, and decision-making workflows across the platform.

Please apply if you have:

- 4+ years of experience in product management, technical product management, or platform product management within a technology environment - equivalent experience, training, or transferable skills are considered.

- Strong knowledge of experimentation methodologies, including A/B testing concepts, statistical foundations (significance, power, confidence intervals, multiple comparisons, and sequential testing), trade-offs, and common pitfalls.

- Experience owning complex products or platforms with multiple collaborators and technical dependencies.

- Strong product and project management skills, including roadmap definition, prioritization, and cross-functional execution.

- Comfort working with engineers and data practitioners on technically complex topics.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

- High ownership, sound judgment, strong analytical skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders without direct authority.

- Experience reading and writing SQL.

Bonus points (not required):

- Hands-on familiarity with the statistics underpinning experimentation - power and sample-size planning, confidence intervals, multiple testing / false discovery, and sequential or group-sequential analysis.

Benefits and Perks

- Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

- Focus on mental health and well-being:

- Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth

- Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace

- Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

- No meeting Fridays

- Paid parental leave

- Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday

- Paid volunteer time

- Focus on your career growth:

- Development Dollars

- Leadership development

- Access to thousands of on-demand

BetterHelp is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there - as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.
As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer at BetterHelp , you’ll join a diverse team of licensed clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. What are we looking for?

We’re seeking someone who brings a strong combination of machine learning, optimization, and software engineering experience. You’ll be responsible for designing and building machine learning and optimization models, as well as partnering closely with Data Scientists to productionize and scale their work. As a key member of the team, you’ll collaborate cross-functionally with Data Engineers, Software Engineers, and Product Managers, playing a pivotal role in shaping how machine learning is applied across the business.

• Partner with data scientists to troubleshoot and optimize complex data pipelines

• Work with product managers and business partners to gather requirements for machine learning models

title: Führungskraft (m/w/d) Eingliederungshilfe & Soziale Teilhabe
description:
Der Caritasverband Rheine e. V. sucht eine Leitung (m/w/d) der Abteilung "Arbeit, Wohnen und Teilhabe", unbefristet in Vollzeit.
Die Caritas Rheine setzt sich als einer der größten Arbeitgeber der Region mit rund 50 sozialen Einrichtungen und Diensten für Menschen ein, die Unterstützung benötigen. Das umfangreiche Angebotsportfolio des Komplexträgers erstreckt sich über die Bereiche Familie, Kinder- und Jugendhilfe, Gefährdeten- und Eingliederungshilfe, Hilfe für suchterkrankte sowie psychisch kranke Menschen, ambulante und stationäre Pflege sowie Migration und Integration. Insgesamt stehen rund 1.800 hauptamtliche Mitarbeitende sowie etwa 500 ehrenamtlich Engagierte den Menschen mit ihren individuellen Bedürfnissen zur Seite.
Die Abteilung Arbeit, Wohnen und Teilhabe des Caritasverbandes Rheine e. V. begleitet Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Unterstützungs- oder Beratungsbedarfen. Menschen mit Behinderungen oder psychischen Erkrankungen befähigen wir, ihr Leben selbstbestimmt zu gestalten und aktiv am gesellschaftlichen Leben teilzuhaben. Mit den Caritas-Emstor-Werkstätten werden vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen Teilhabe, Qualifizierung und persönlichen Entwicklung geschaffen. Im Jacob-Meyersohn-Wohnverbund unterstützen wir Menschen mit Behinderungen durch ambulante Angebote sowie in verschiedenen Wohnformen. Die Fachbereiche Ambulante Dienste und Existenzsicherung sowie Sozialpsychiatrische Dienste bieten Menschen in unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen umfassende Unterstützung. Dazu gehören unter anderem Wohnangebote in Gruppenform, Ambulant Betreutes Wohnen, psychosoziale Beratung, gesetzliche Betreuung sowie das Sozialkaufhaus. Im Haus St. Antonius in Bevergern erhalten Erwachsene mit psychischen Erkrankungen im Rahmen medizinischer Rehabilitationsmaßnahmen die Möglichkeit, neue Perspektiven zu entwickeln.

Wirtschaftliche, konzeptionelle und fachlich-strategische Leitung der Abteilung

About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. 

 

About the Role

Support Fanatics Collect's Unified Experience initiative, building seamless collector journeys across Fanatics Live, Marketplace, Instant Rips, Collections, Topps, and future experiences.

Today a collector can win a card in a live show, rip a pack, buy on the marketplace, and store it all in a vault - but those moments still feel like separate products. Your job is to make them feel like one. That means building the shared surfaces, APIs, and front-end systems that connect experiences that were each built independently, and doing it without slowing any of them down.

This is a hands-on senior role. You'll own meaningful slices of the unified experience end to end - schema to API to UI - and you'll do it alongside a Staff Backend Engineer, mobile engineers, product, and design.

 

Why Join Us

Fanatics Collect is growing fast, and the unification work is the highest-leverage engineering investment we have: every new app, drop, and live format gets easier once the shared foundation exists. You'll work across mobile, web, and internal tools, with real autonomy and a short path from idea to production. Your teammates are passionate about the space and most of them are collectors themselves.

 

Product Context and Scale

Our surfaces reach millions of collectors across iOS, Android, and web, with live, high-traffic moments (breaks, drops, auctions closing) that make performance and reliability non-negotiable. You'll be working in a landscape of multiple existing products with real users and real data, so migration, backward compatibility, and careful rollout are part of the craft.

 

First 90 Days

- Ship a meaningful, user-facing piece of the unified experience end to end.
- Build a working map of how Live, Marketplace, Instant Rips, Collections, and Topps actually fit together today - data models, identity, entitlements, and the seams between them.
- Establish working relationships with the backend, mobile, product, and design partners you'll depend on.
- Identify one piece of duplicated or divergent logic across surfaces and make the case for consolidating it.

 

Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain fullstack features using Python, FastAPI, Next.js, React, and TypeScript.
- Build scalable, performant, highly available services and interfaces on AWS and Vercel.
- Own features end to end: data model, API contract, front-end implementation, tests, rollout, and post-launch metrics.
- Build and maintain reusable front-end components, APIs, and shared libraries that multiple apps (web and mobile) depend on - and treat other engineers as first-class consumers of what you build.
- Contribute to cross-surface concerns like shared identity, entitlements, inventory, and navigation betwee

title: Forensic Utility Bill Auditor
description:
At Limitlessli , we specialize in recruiting, hiring, and managing high-caliber remote staff for dynamic and growing healthcare facilities. Leveraging our extensive global network, we connect clients with highly qualified professionals, offering meticulously tailored services to meet our clients' unique business needs.

The Opportunity:

We are looking for a highly analytical and detail-oriented Forensic Utility Bill Auditor / Data Analyst to join our team. In this role, you will review and analyze utility accounts-including gas, electric, and water-to identify billing errors, incorrect rate classifications, tariff misapplications, unusual usage patterns, and potential overcharges.

You will work with utility bills, customer portals, spreadsheets, AI-powered data extraction tools, and public property information to investigate anomalies and help build evidence supporting potential audit findings and recovery claims.

This position is remote and offers you the flexibility of working from home.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Review customer utility accounts and billing histories to identify high-value accounts requiring further investigation.

• Download and organize historical utility bills and supporting documentation.

• Prepare clear, accurate, and professional communications to utility providers outlining identified billing discrepancies, suspected errors, and supporting findings for further investigation and resolution.

• Create and maintain standardized folder structures and audit files for each client, utility type, account, or property.

• Prioritize accounts based on billing thresholds and potential financial impact.

• Standardize utility statements into clean, readable PDFs suitable for data extraction and analysis.

• Use AI-powered tools to extract up to 24 months of utility billing data into structured spreadsheets.

• Analyze billing information using Month-over-Month (MoM) and Year-over-Year (YoY) comparisons.

• Review key data points, including:

• Billing cycle dates

• Total monthly charges

• Energy or utility consumption

• Rates and tariffs

• Meter types and rate classes

• Itemized charges, including generation, transmission, and delivery costs

• Identify irregular usage patterns, billing anomalies, potentially unjustified charges, and other indicators of possible overbilling.

• Perform detailed quality assurance by manually validating AI-generated data against the original utility bills.

• Research property characteristics, including square footage, property type, and visible operational factors that may impact utility usage.

• Prepare targeted questions for clients to better understand property operations and consumption patterns.

• Investigate suspected billing errors, including incorrect rate classes, meter types, and tariff violations.

• Support the calculation of potential historical overcharges and assist in documenting the evidence behind audit findings.

• Independently verify utility tariffs, rate schedules, regulations, and other supporting documentation using official published sources before finalizing findings.

• Manage multiple high-priority accounts simultaneously while maintaining accuracy, organization, and attention to detail.

The role requires a combination of data extraction, benchmarking, manual quality assurance, property research, and tariff validation.

Qualifications & Experience Required:

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Data Analytics, Business, Engineering, Energy Management , or a related field is preferred.

• Previous experience in data analysis, auditing, utility billing, energy management, financial analysis, or forensic analysis is highly desirable.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify patterns, anomalies, discrepancies, and potential errors within large sets of financial and operational data.

• Excellent written communication skills.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets , including data organiza

title: [Web3] 資金主管 Liquidity & FX Lead (Mandarin-speaking)
description:
About BTSE :

BTSE Group is a global leader in fintech and blockchain technology, anchored by three core business pillars: Exchange, Payments, and Infrastructure Development. Serving over 100 corporate clients worldwide, we provide white-label exchange and payment solutions. Our offerings encompass everything from exchange infrastructure hosting and development to custody, wallets, payments, blockchain integration, trading, and more. We are looking for talented professionals in marketing, operations, customer support, and other departments. The roles offered may be on-site, remote, or hybrid, in collaboration with our local partner.
About the Opportunity:
We are looking for a Liquidity & Funding Lead. In this role, you will be responsible for managing the organisation’s liquidity position to ensure optimal funding availability, efficient cash utilisation, and compliance with regulatory and internal requirements. This role involves monitoring daily liquidity, forecasting cash flow, optimising working capital, managing bank relationships, and supporting treasury projects related to liquidity management and risk mitigation.
Responsibilities:

Liquidity Management

• Lead daily monitoring of the group’s cash and liquidity position across entities and currencies.

• Oversee preparation of cash flow forecasts (short-, medium-, and long-term) and ensure accuracy.

• Develop and maintain liquidity risk metrics, limits, and stress-testing scenarios.

• Implement and monitor liquidity contingency funding plans.
Funding Strategy & Capital Planning

• Design and execute funding strategies to support business growth and capital needs.

• Manage credit facilities, intercompany loans, and external funding arrangements.

• Evaluate cost of capital and recommend optimal funding mix.

• Support balance sheet and capital structure planning in collaboration with Finance and Risk.
Risk & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with internal treasury policies, governance frameworks, and regulatory liquidity requirements (e.g., Basel III LCR/NSFR, where applicable).

• Identify liquidity and funding risks and escalate timely to senior management.

• Provide support for audits, reviews, and regulatory submissions.
Reporting & Systems

• Deliver liquidity and funding reports, KPIs, and dashboards to senior management.

• Provide analysis and insights for Board and ALCO (Asset-Liability Committee) reporting.

• Enhance treasury systems and automation for cash and liquidity management.

Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field.

• 3-5 years’ experience in treasury, liquidity, or cash management roles (banking, payments, or fintech/crypto sector an advantage).

• Strong knowledge of liquidity risk metrics, cash forecasting, and banking operations.

• Proficiency in treasury systems, ERP, and Excel (advanced formulas, pivot tables).

• Familiarity with regulatory requirements for safeguarding funds and VASP compliance is desirable.

• Solid analytical and problem-solving skills; attention to detail.

• Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management abilities.

• Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.

• High integrity with commitment to governance and controls.

• Proactive, adaptable, and process-improvement mindset.

Perks & Benefits:

• Competitive total compensation package

• Various team building programs and company events

• And many more! Apply and let us tell you more!

title: SDR - Porto
description:
Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

SDR

Serás o primeiro ponto de contacto entre a Teya e potenciais comerciantes. O teu papel será identificar e qualificar potenciais clientes, iniciar conversas relevantes e transformar a prospeção em oportunidades comerciais reais para a nossa equipa de Field Sales.

Sobre a função

O SDR está na linha da frente da operação comercial, os leads chegam até ti já identificados, tratados e classificados, permitindo-te concentrar o teu tempo no que realmente importa: criar boas conversas, compreender necessidades e identificar oportunidades com potencial.

Trabalhas uma lista de leads prioritizada e realizas o primeiro contacto sobretudo por telefone, complementando a abordagem através de email e redes sociais. O teu papel passa por perceber rapidamente se existe fit entre o potencial cliente e a solução, avaliar o seu nível de interesse e identificar se está preparado para avançar para uma conversa comercial.

A tua responsabilidade acompanha todo o processo até à reunião agendada. O fecho da venda fica a cargo do vendedor, mas continuas a ser co-responsável pelas oportunidades que geraste e passaste à equipa. O teu trabalho não termina quando a reunião é marcada: acompanhas a qualidade das oportunidades que crias, assegurando que cada lead qualificado está devidamente associado ao teu contributo e ao impacto que geraste no processo comercial.

O que vais fazer

- Trabalhar uma fila prioritizada de leads classificados com base no perfil e na intenção, fazendo o primeiro contacto principalmente por telefone e utilizando email e redes sociais como complemento.

- Qualificar cada lead com base num conjunto claro de critérios: este negócio tem o perfil adequado e este é o momento certo para conversar?

- Agendar os comerciantes qualificados diretamente na agenda de um vendedor de Field Sales, com pelo menos 48 horas de antecedência, e garantir a realização da reunião através de uma confirmação e de um lembrete no dia anterior.

- Sinalizar leads que demonstram potencial mas precisam de ser contactados num momento mais adequado.

- Encerrar os leads que não têm o perfil adequado, registando um motivo claro e honesto.

- Manter o CRM organizado: registos precisos, notas claras e estados atualizados. A pessoa seguinte no processo depende da informação que registas.

O que vais trazer

- Conforto ao telefone e capacidade para ter uma conversa próxima e útil com um proprietário de um negócio que não estava à espera da tua chamada.

- Capacidade para ouvir mais do que apresentar, percebendo a diferença entre uma oportunidade real e um simples “talvez”.

- Organização e consistência: trabalhas a lista, fazes o follow-up dentro dos prazos e manténs os teus registos atualizados.

- Capacidade para lidar com um “não” com naturalidade e manter uma energia constante ao longo de um dia completo de chamadas.

- Facilidade na utilização de um CRM e de ferramentas modernas de vendas, ou capacidade para aprender rapidamente novas ferramentas.

- Fluência em português.

Será valorizad

title: Product Manager, Onboarding and Growth
description:
Hi, I’m Geo, Ashby’s VP of Product. I joined Ashby August ‘26; read more about why I joined here. https://www.ashbyhq.com/blog/all/a-letter-from-chris-geoghegan-on-joining-ashby I’m looking for a growth-oriented product manager to help users onboard and expand their usage of the product.

At Ashby, we have a unique approach to building products https://www.ashbyhq.com/blog/culture/ashbys-operating-principles (more on that below). As a PM, your primary goal is to eliminate frustration and bring delight to our customers. You’ll work with engineers who deeply understand the customer and business problem and own the solution end-to-end. This means that you spend less time writing detailed specs and more time with customers and doing deep product thinking.

Our unique approach is working. We’re growing >100% year over year and have notable customers such as Notion, Linear, OpenAI, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best in class among our peers. We’re backed by amazing investors like Y Combinator, Elad Gil, Lachy Groom, and many more!

THE CHALLENGE

The surface area of our flagship ATS product is growing, and we are launching new products. This means customers are less likely to organically adopt the things that create value for them.

Historically, onboarding has been human-driven by our amazing Customer Success team https://www.ashbyhq.com/blog/culture/customer-success. And now, we’re ready to productize our learnings. As Ashby grows, we need a single owner who can think deeply about the customer journey and design the product and email experiences that help users achieve their desired outcomes and get the most out of Ashby.

This isn’t just about onboarding individuals. It requires thinking about how to onboard organizations with different roles and stakeholders with different goals. It’s going to be a fun challenge.

WHAT YOU’LL BE WORKING ON

- Customer Journey: This role isn’t focused on conversion rate optimization or running A/B tests. Instead, you’ll gain a deep understanding of the entire Customer Journey. Then you’ll design a thoughtful onboarding experience for each role, prioritizing how we can use the product and email to help users at different stages.

- Product Led Growth: You’ll spearhead our product-led growth motion by working closely with our Customer Success team. They own our human-led onboarding and, in many respects, have designed the first version of this. You’ll also own transactional email (i.e. email triggered by product signals) as it is an extension of the product experience.

- Adoption Metrics: This is our first-ever product team focused on growth and onboarding, so you’ll be responsible for defining and tracking key metrics to assess whether our onboarding experience helps customers realize value sooner. We have a small but mighty data team that you’ll partner with, but for the most part, you’ll be responsible for defining and analyzing these growth metrics yourself.

- Product Qualified Leads: You’ll also work closely with our Revenue Operations team to figure out the bridge between product signals that initiate go-to-market activity. You’ll own the definition of a Product Qualified Lead (PQL) and work with the RevOps team to determine how to route them.
